notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Necromancy Revival
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Neutral camps[/h1][/b]
[b]Camps are located on neutral sectors. There are various types of undead in the camps:[/b]
[list]
[*] Skeleton Warrior (fast and weak infantry with huge ranged defence)
[*] Zombie Warrior (slow and tenacious infantry)
[*] Zombie Archer (slow and strong unit)
[*] Skeleton Mage (strong long-range mage)
[*] Mounted Zombie (tenacious and fast cavalry)
[*] Necromancer (powerful long-range cavalry mage)
[/list]
[b]When you defeat camps you get various random trophies:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resources
[*] Technologies
[*] Necrotic gifts (only way to get)
[/list]
[b][h1]Necromancer's Lair[/h1][/b]
Pick the perfect combination of troops to go to the lair.
Defeat an army of rising undead as one of the three races to protect the continent from darkness.


[b][h1]Rework of Divine Gifts[/h1][/b]
[b]When accepting the gift you can choose one of five random gifts. Each gift has its own negative effect. These effects vary by strength:[/b]
[list]
[*] Slight
[*] Average
[*] Severe
[/list]
[b]The negative effect is random, but is 1 of 3 types:[/b]
[list]
[*] Economic
[*] Defensive
[*] Offensive
[/list]
[b]Gifts that have been removed: [/b]
[list]
[*] Gift of confidence
[*] Gift of swiftness
[*] Gift of greed
[*] Gift of hardness
[*] Gift of rage
[*] Gift of ferocity
[/list]
[b]New gifts:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Bone armor[/b]
  First enemy attack vs each of your units will be decreased by 40%.
[*][b]Necrotic factory[/b]
  Each turn creates 2 Skeleton Warriors in capital. Permanently reduces population growth by 1.
[*][b]Immortal army[/b]
  20% of dead units rise up as Zombie Warrior.
[*][b]Amulet of corruption[/b]
  In battles with your hero, the enemy squad takes 3 pure damage for each unit at the end of each turn.
[*][b]Necronomicon[/b]
  Each turn creates 2 Skeleton Mages in capital. Permanently reduces population growth by 2.
[/list]
[b][h1]Balance changes[/h1][/b]
[b][h2]Gifts[/h2][/b]
[b]Frozen magic:[/b]
[list]
[*] multiplier: [strike]10%[/strike] -> 15%
[/list]
[b]Reforging:[/b]
[list]
[*] multiplier: [strike]3%[/strike] -> 5%
[/list]
[b]Earth fury:[/b]
[list]
[*] power: [strike]2[/strike] -> 3
[/list]
[h1]Interface improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]During the preparation for the battle, cells available to unit placement turn yellow.[/b]
[*] [b]During the battle, cells available for movement turn green.[/b]
[*] [b]Added gifts descriptions in the battle log.[/b]
[*] [b]Added the player list in the session.[/b]
[*] [b]Many small changes.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: 1.01 Update. Small bugfix and interface changes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Dwarven "Health Theft" can restore units up to max for the stack.
[*] You should confirm to log out of the active session.
[*] It's possible to delete a save in the loading window.
[/list]
